name: Necromancer
description: A dark caster who raises the dead to fight alongside the party, draining life from foes to fuel unholy magic.
lore: Exiled from the Arcane Collegium for forbidden research, Necromancers draw power from the boundary between life and death. Their undead servants are tireless, fearless, and utterly expendable.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.description: Hurls a bolt of dark energy at a single enemy.

abilities.name: Raise Skeleton
abilities.description: Raises a skeleton warrior from the ground that fights alongside the party for 5 turns.

abilities.name: Bone Armor
abilities.description: Encases the Necromancer in a shield of bones, increasing Physical DEF by 30% and Dark Resistance by 10% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Drains life force from an enemy, dealing 1.2x dark damage and healing the Necromancer for 50% of damage dealt.

abilities.name: Summon Wraith
abilities.description: Summons a phasing wraith that ignores enemy Physical DEF and attacks with dark damage for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Corpse Explosion
abilities.description: Detonates fallen minions, dealing 1.8x dark damage to all enemies. Bonus damage if a summon was recently destroyed.

abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.description: Passive: All summons gain 20% increased ATK, +1 turn duration, and the Necromancer gains an additional 10% Dark Resistance.

abilities.name: Army of the Dead
abilities.description: Ultimate: Raises a legion of 3 undead minions for 4 turns. When each minion falls, it explodes for dark AoE damage.

synergies: Warrior: Warrior holds aggro while Necromancer builds an undead army safely from the back line
Witch: Witch curses reduce enemy resistances, amplifying the Necromancer's dark damage
Cleric: Cleric keeps the fragile Necromancer alive, but holy magic conflicts thematically
weaknesses: Extremely fragile — low STA and no defensive abilities
Holy damage is devastating due to negative holy resistance
Summons take time to build up — vulnerable in the first few turns
High MP costs drain resources quickly without careful management
hire_description: A gaunt figure in tattered robes sits alone in the corner, skeletal fingers tracing symbols on the table. The candle beside them flickers without wind. "The dead remember everything. Shall I introduce you?"
